change: After Copilot+Tab expands a preview, release the keys and press Tab alone to fold the selected preview immediately.

verified: Copilot+Tab expands a preview; releasing both keys and pressing Tab alone folds it without opening or dismissing any chat.
Every other tab remains available and no other preview expands.
Later plain Tab presses do not re-expand the preview.
Holding Copilot continues cycling and Enter opens the exact selected chat.
Released macro prefixes support a fresh Copilot+Tab cycle; the automatic three-second fold remains active.
Custom shortcuts and live tab limits still work.
nativeDesktopTests.scope: Owned Windows overlays and simulated shortcut-thread events. No desktop key injection; the physical OEM Copilot key was not exercised.

keyboardRegressionCoverage: Tab can fold an expanded selection both before and after the 1.5-second activation chord expires.
Folded, replaced, mouse-expanded, and mouse-reopened previews leave ordinary Tab alone.
Typing or a different foreground app cancels the plain-Tab target.
Shift+Tab and Ctrl+Tab are not intercepted after releasing Copilot.
Auto-repeat does not act twice, and consumed key-down events have matching key-up handling.
